This Santa Fe has been with one family since it was registered and has been serviced every year at 15,000 km, with the invoices to show for it. The timing chain, brake discs and pads were done at 120,000 km and it has four good Michelin tyres. Inside it is clean and tidy: the seven seats fold flat, there is a full set of mats, and both keys are here. It has just had a full valet. Outside there is one small mark on the rear bumper, which we have photographed so you can see it before you visit. It drives straight and quiet with no warning lights, and the NCT is in date. You are welcome to bring a mechanic of your choice to look it over before you buy, and we will take your current car in part exchange.

Call in to see it, or book a test drive. Part exchange welcome and finance available.
